note: Computer-use requests with the route each one should take. 'log' cases are the owner's own requests from ~/.config/eve-bridge/agent-runs (2026-09), de-duplicated, with every personal detail replaced by a neutral one of the same shape; 'authored' cases are hard negatives and positives written to probe the rules. Labels are a human judgement of the cheapest tier that fully and safely does the request. This is the TUNING set: the rules were adjusted against it, so its score is not evidence. holdout.json, written by an author who had not seen the rules, makes the ship decision.
